What this page learned in the first second

Each detail on its own is common. Together they can single you out. The rating shows how much a detail helps someone tell you apart from other people.

Can ad networks reach you?

Ad blockers and privacy browsers stop your browser from talking to ad and tracking servers. These checks show whether yours does.

Ad and tracking servers

Runs when you choose · contacts outside servers

This check tries to reach 12 well-known ad and tracking servers, the same ones that load on most news and shopping sites. Those companies will see your IP address, just as they do whenever you browse. We send no cookies and no information about you.

    A real ad, served to you

    Not set up yet

    This would show the ad an ad network picks for your browser right now. It needs an ad account linked to this site, so it is switched off for now.

    See your real ad profile

    This page shows what any site can see. The companies that sell ads also keep a profile of your interests. These steps let you see it, and change it.

    See what platforms think you like

    Google and Meta list the interests and advertisers they use to target you.

    • Google My Ad Center
    • Meta ad preferences
    • Amazon advertising preferences
    • Microsoft ad settings

    TikTok keeps its ad settings in the app, under Settings and privacy, then Ads.

    Download the data they hold

    In the UK and EU, data protection law gives you the right to a copy of your personal data. California and other US states give similar rights. The export usually lists advertisers who uploaded your details.

    • Google Takeout
    • Meta: download your information

    Exports can take from minutes to a few days. Soon you will be able to open them here, privately in your browser.

    Opt out of interest-based ads

    Industry opt-out pages let you turn off personalised ads from many networks at once. They work by setting cookies, so they reset if you clear cookies.

    • YourAdChoices (US)
    • Your Online Choices (UK and EU)

    Track your ads over time

    A browser extension will record the ads you are shown and the ones you click, so you can spot the patterns advertisers rely on. Everything will stay on your device.

    In development.

    Save these results to compare after you change your settings or switch browsers.

    How this page works

    Ad Mirror has no server, no cookies and no analytics. Everything above is worked out by your own browser and disappears when you close the tab. The only outside requests happen when you run the server check, and the counter at the top shows every one.
